concerns.text: The plan states that no verified open dataset contains the required combination of process parameters, measured residual stress, and fatigue life, and therefore the full analysis will be performed on a synthetic dataset (`synthetic_fatigue.csv`). Using synthetic data does not provide evidence about the real-world impact of residual stress on fatigue life, which is the core research question. This constitutes a wrong‑dataset issue; the methodology cannot answer the claim without real observational data.
